entries.en: Was today a good day to die?
Good fight. I almost had him.
At least I got him, too...
How do you like my clavicle?
There's no way that hit me!
At least I died a warrior.
Sorry you saw me like that.
I am forever in your debt.
Boy, was I ever done in!
I feel like causing a ruckus.
You need me, you know it.
You okay? I'm here to help!
Why didn't anyone wake me up?
Don't let them find my shield!
I'm glad I didn't die young.
Lo, I was slain! And unslain!
I'll buy you a drink later.
Come on! Pick me! Do it now!
We will make a great team!
I'll carve us a way forward!
Do you like my new armor?
It took 300 of 'em to stop me.
Did I leave a lantern burning?
It's good not to be dead!
I owe you one. Just one.
You just made a new friend!
I knew I was too good to die!
Dwarf your party up a notch!
Hey! We go WAY back, right?
I'll throw you into last week!
I'm fed up with being dead.
Thank you for not leaving me.
It feels good to be alive.
I'm more than meets the eye!
I can't take it any more!
I should be able to help.
Woo hoo! This looks like fun!
Flowers die and so did I...
Don't turn me into a skeleton!
Is this my fate? Fate sucks!
Please, tell him I loved him.
I was single my whole life...
That was the worst day ever!
I'm too pretty to be dead!
Who would do this to me?
It feels good to be alive!
I'm not just a pretty skull.
I'm here to save the day!
Why did I stand and fight...?
I had begun to lose hope.
Was I talking in my death?
I will lay waste to all foes!
I'll show you a magic bonanza!
Heal me if I'm hurt, okay?
Magicked up and good to go.
I'm not here to make friends.
